contract_content.allowed_action: run bounded synthetic network-egress classification probes against the existing pc3 VM via isolated LIMA_HOME

allowed_probe_commands.purpose: confirm isolated VM status and effective config before network classification

argv: (command -v ip >/dev/null && ip route || true); (command -v resolvectl >/dev/null && resolvectl dns || true)
allowed_probe_commands.purpose: inspect guest route and resolver configuration without changing state

argv: timeout 5 getent hosts example.com >/dev/null && echo dns_example_com_available || echo dns_example_com_unavailable
allowed_probe_commands.purpose: classify DNS resolution availability for one public documentation domain

argv: command -v bash >/dev/null && timeout 5 bash -lc ': >/dev/tcp/1.1.1.1/443' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo tcp_1_1_1_1_443_open || echo tcp_1_1_1_1_443_closed_or_unavailable
allowed_probe_commands.purpose: classify outbound TCP reachability to one public IP on port 443 without sending HTTP credentials or payload

result_interpretation.egress_not_observed: This bounded probe did not observe egress, but production no-egress still requires an enforceable policy before profile use.
result_interpretation.egress_observed: Lima default guest egress is available; no-egress claim remains blocked until a containment design is implemented.
